info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Materials-v2-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollments Materials API provides access to a comprehensive list of materials associated with educational enrollments. This API allows developers to retrieve relevant data about the educational resources linked to student enrollments, facilitating better insights and resource management. Typical consumers include educational institutions, course managers, and administrative systems looking to enhance their reporting or resource allocation processes. By using this API, organizations can ensure they have the necessary materials to support student success and engagement.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of materials associated with enrollments, providing necessary resources for students and educators involved in the enrollment process.
